description: Five real activations from the seed-42 dataset, chosen because each shows one behaviour of the scoring service worth protecting from regression. Only identifiers, true labels and expected bands are stored; the request payloads are rebuilt from data/ by src.serve.testing.build_request_payload, which is deterministic for a given dataset. The true labels are hidden generator variables and are never sent to the service. Expected bands are for the artifacts t0_none-isotonic-v1 and t7_none-isotonic-v1 at their thresholds in outputs/band_operating_point_t0.csv and outputs/band_operating_point.csv; if those artifacts are retrained or the thresholds change, this file must be re-checked deliberately.

records.why_kept: Baseline: an ordinary genuine activation is released at both decision points.
SIM farming, the fraud pattern the model catches best, is refused at both decision points.
The two decision points disagree: fraud released at submission is only queued for review at hold-close, after the payout has already been made.
Known miss: collusion looks like honest work at submission and is released at both decision points.
Fairness gap: genuine work by a high-volume agent is held at both decision points.
